event.description:
Format - Constructed, Best of Three
Date - 2/21/26
Location - 1818 W Bell Rd Suite 115, Phoenix, AZ 85023
Registration Time - 9:00am - 10:15am
Start Time - 10:30am

Entry Fee - $35
Prize Payout - 
1st: 1x PTM Season Regional Champion Playmat featuring the art of Remnant of Will

Top 16: 
1x Nationals Qualifier card Poisoned Dagger, featuring Zander
1x PTM Season Regional Finalist Playmat featuring the art of Cleansing Reunion

Remaining Phantom Monarchs Event Packs will be split among top players. 

Remaining Phantom Monarchs Sapphire Packs will be distributed to top players with a higher quantity going to the players with higher placing.

Entry Prize: 
3x Grand Archive Phantom Monarchs Booster Pack
1x Phantom Monarchs Event Pack
1x Regionals Binder featuring Merlin, Brilliant Vestige
1x Phantom Monarchs Sapphire Pack

Additional Prizing in store credit:
32 players:
1st: $200
2nd: $100
3rd-4th: $60
5th-8th: $35

48 players:
2x Grand Archive Phantom Monarchs Booster Pack added as participation prize 

64 players:
1st: $200
2nd: $100
3rd-4th: $60
5th-8th: $35
9th-16th: $25

80 players:
1st: $300
2nd: $150
3rd-4th: $75
5th-8th: $45
9th-16th: $25

Max Player Count - 80
Number of Rounds - up to 7
Time Per Round - 60 minutes
Contact Point - nphx.events@gamersguildusa.com 

Description - Grand Archive Regionals are Swiss style tournaments which award the top placing players Nationals Qualifier Cards in addition to other prizes. These cards will be worth 3 Nationals Qualifier Points toward the
 2026 Nationals events. Players may win multiple duplicate prize cards, but only the first unique copy is redeemable for points at Nationals.

Deck list submission through Omnidex is required. 

45 minute Lunch Break after Round 3. 

Estimated Schedule:
9:00am - 10:15am: Registration
10:30am - 11:35am: Round 1
11:35am - 12:40pm: Round 2
12:40pm - 1:45pm: Round 3
1:45pm - 2:30pm: Lunch (45 minutes)
2:30pm - 3:35pm: Round 4
3:35pm - 4:40pm: Round 5
4:40pm - 5:45pm: Round 6
5:45pm - 6:50pm: Round 7
